label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

findings.problem: The rotating banner at the top of the home page kept stealing focus: pressing Tab bounced between the same two banner links and the Next button instead of moving on, so I had to go back and use the skip link to get past it

element.name: Get a King size mattress for the price of a Queen

findings.problem: Keyboard focus got trapped on the product video: Tab, Shift+Tab, Escape, Space, Enter, arrows, Home, End and Backspace all left focus on it, so I could never reach the size options or the Add to cart button

element.name: A video of a couple carrying their new mattress in its box up the stairs to their bedroom, then lying in bed and smiling.

findings.problem: Six separate Zoom buttons with identical names, all just called Zoom button, must be tabbed through one by one before the buy options, and they do not say which picture they zoom
Every page starts with a long header and the Skip to content link lands on the main area, but the first product link after it is a footnote link called [name]. Value, so it is slow to reach a product
Rating buttons are named only by the number such as 4.3, so the name alone does not say it is a rating or that it jumps to reviews
